proposals.lexicon_quote: The F-35 engine is being modernized with the F135 Engine Core Upgrade (ECU), which is part of the Engine, Power, and Thermal Management
proposals.rationale: §3 platform/component reject plus a money-colour failure. The F135 is the engine the F-35 C2D2 line modernizes; this award buys none of that work — it procures 'milling machines, fixtures and tooling to increase production capacity', an industrial-base action paid with 'Fiscal 2019 defense production act purchases (Defense) funds'. DPA purchases are not the RDT&E C2D2 appropriation, and the announcement never names the Engine Core Upgrade.
